name: Festival of Fears
author: YoyoNow & Grumbletok
description:
"The time has come yet again; a wondrous new spring, the swallows fly high in the sky, the world is turning green around us and it is time to celebrate its renewal.
It is at this time we honor our old tradition and for just a day distill and share our emotions, give of ourselves and bring our experiences together
for a bright and beautiful year to come. Welcome, dear friends, to the Festival of Swallows."

Lanterns glow along the winding streets, and stalls overflow with shimmering vials—each containing a carefully brewed potion of emotion. Love, joy, courage, even nostalgia—every bottle a promise of fleeting but potent feeling, shared among friends, lovers, and strangers alike.

Music swells as revelers sip their chosen brews, laughter spilling into the night like spilled honeyed mead. Couples dance, old grudges dissolve, and for one enchanted evening, the town beats with a single jubilant heart. But among the euphoria, a shadow stirs.

As the festival goes on, a bitter note creeps into the air, unnoticed at first, save for the unlucky few. A smiling youth who drinks a vial of giddy delight collapses into silent horror. A merchant's toast to prosperity leaves him trembling, his mind consumed by unseen terrors. A lonely soul seeking warmth in a flask of affection finds only a deep, seething hatred instead.

Eyes dart nervously. Fearful whispers ripple through the crowds. Somewhere in the throng, an unseen hand has tainted the celebration. A masked figure slips between the stalls, watching, waiting, delighting in the slow unraveling of joy.

The Festival of Fears has begun.
bootlegger: When a player is about to die or be exiled all their potions break before death. You cannot hold multiple Potion of the same type. [+0/+1 Storyteller]

This Script is run with a Cauldron which contains the public information of potions held by players. During the day all potions are by default displayed as face down. During the night all evil potions are displayed as face up. Once nominations begin players may not eye the cauldron.

While eyeing the cauldron any player may once per day request to reveal the good potions they are holding to all currently eyeing the cauldron. After such a reveal the potions are once again flipped face down. While eyeing the cauldron players may not document its content.

name: Botanist
First Night Reminder: Wake up the Botanist and show them the tokens of 2 good characters, 1 which is in play and 1 that is one of the demon's bluffs.
ability: You start knowing 2 good characters; 1 is in play and 1 is a demon bluff.
flavor: Man, that's groovy.

name: Scout
First Night Reminder: Wake the Scout and signal a number equal to the highest number of Townsfolk players sitting in a line.
ability: You start knowing the longest chain of Townfolk players. [+0/+1 Outsiders]

special.name: card
special.value: The longest chain of townsfolk players is:

name: Glassblower
First Night Reminder: Hand out as many potions as the voting majority minus 1, divided amongst any number of players.
Other Night Reminder: Hand out as many potions as the voting majority minus 1, divided amongst any number of alive players.
ability: Each night, potions equal to the voting majority minus 1 are given out.
flavor: Sometimes, the most beautiful creations are born from shattered dreams.

name: Toxicologist
First Night Reminder: Wake up the Toxicologist and show them the Cauldron. Then have them choose 2 other players. Put the Toxicologist to sleep and then remove a potion from 1 of the chosen players if possible.
Other Night Reminder: Wake up the Toxicologist and show them the Cauldron. Then have them choose 2 other, alive players. Put the Toxicologist to sleep and then remove a potion from 1 of the chosen players if possible.
ability: Each night eye the cauldron, choose 2 alive players (not yourself); a potion one of them holds break.
flavor: Exposure to toxins in our environment can have serious health consequences, so it’s important to take steps to minimize our exposure.

name: Sommelier
ability: Each night one player who would receive a potion might receive one of the opposite alignment instead.
flavor: The discovery of a wine is of greater moment than the discovery of a constellation. The universe is too full of stars.
howtorun: If a person would receive a duplicate potion they cannot and this ability cannot trigger!

name: Farrier
First Night Reminder: Wake up the Farrier and have them choose another player. Then signal them either yes or no, dependent on if that player is seated closer to an evil player other than themselves, than the Farrier is seated to an evil player.
Other Night Reminder: Wake up the Farrier and have them choose another player that they have not chosen previously. Then signal them either yes or no, dependent on if that player is seated closer to an evil player other than themselves, than the Farrier is seated to an evil player.
ability: Each night, choose a new player (not yourself); you learn if they are closer to an evil player (not themselves) than you are.
flavor: Well, that is close. But close only counts for hand grenades.

special.name: card
special.value: You are closer to an evil player.

special.name: card
special.value: They are closer to an evil player.

name: Snake Oil Seller
firstNightReminder: Point to a good and a evil Potion. Then ask the Snake Oil Seller to either point to one of the shown Potions or to a Player. Put them to sleep. If they pointed at a Potion, wake any player and tell them they received that Potion. If they pointed at a player, wake that player and tell them that they received 1 of the 2 shown Potions.
otherNightReminder: Point to a good and a evil Potion. Then ask the Snake Oil Seller to either point to one of the shown Potions or to a Player. Put them to sleep. If they pointed at a Potion, wake any player and tell them they received that Potion. If they pointed at a player, wake that player and tell them that they received 1 of the 2 shown Potions.
ability: Each night you learn a good and an evil potion. Choose either 1) which potion for a player to receive, or 2) which player to receive either potion.
flavor: In my scientific opinion, the existence of a Demon would have an impact of gigantic proportions: mythology and legend would become history and science. One could really make a quick buck with it

name: Chemist
First Night Reminder: Wake up the Chemist and show them the Cauldron. Have them choose either 1 or 2. If they choose 1, have them choose 2 potions in the Cauldron and then swap those potion's places. If they choose 2, have them choose a good potion held by another player; move it to them and replace it with an Empty Potion.
Other Night Reminder: Wake up the Chemist and show them the Cauldron. Have them choose either 1 or 2. If they choose 1, have them choose 2 potions in the Cauldron and then swap those potion's places. If they choose 2, have them choose a good potion held by another player; move it to them and replace it with an Empty Potion.
ability: Each night, eye the cauldron; either choose 1) 2 potions to swap places, or 2) a good potion another player holds; you receive it, theirs is emptied.
flavor: Life is just chemicals. A drop here, a drip there, everything's changed.

name: Thug
firstNightReminder: Wake up the Thug and have them choose a player and a character. Put the Thug's Mad reminder token on that player. Put the Thug to sleep and wake up the chosen player. Inform them that they were chosen by the Thug and the character chosen by the Thug.
otherNightReminder: Wake up the Thug and have them choose a player and a character. Put the Thug's Mad reminder token on that player. Put the Thug to sleep and wake up the chosen player. Inform them that they were chosen by the Thug and the character chosen by the Thug.
ability: Each night, choose a player and a character; tomorrow they are "mad" that that character is NOT play or 2 players might receive an evil potion.
flavor: You're humming, Sam. That means that something awful is going to happen to somebody.

name: Toll Inspector
otherNightReminder: Wake up the Toll Inspector and show them the cauldron.
ability: Each night*, eye the cauldron.
flavor: I had to pay a ransom of six hundred pounds in gold. All might have gone well even yet, only that, by ins and outs and crookedness of laws, I was shorn like a sheep that is clipped to the quick.

name: Distiller
otherNightReminder: Wake up the Distiller and have them choose 2 alive players. Then put them to sleep and either put a good Potion on one of the choosen players, or remove an evil potion from one of the choosen players.
ability: Each night*, choose 2 alive players; 1 receives a good potion or 1 of their evil potions break.
flavor: Ein Glas ist fabelhaft, zwei sind zu viel, und drei zu wenig.

name: Clofou
otherNightReminder: Wake up the Clofou and have them choose a player. Then put them back to sleep and put the Clofou's Dead reminder token on the chosen player. Then put an evil potion on an Outsider if possible.
ability: Each night*, choose a player; they die. Then an Outsider receives an evil potion. [+1 Outsider]
flavor: The saints were his friends, and blessed him; the monsters were his friends, and guarded him.

name: Harlot
otherNightReminder: The Harlot points at any player. Then, put the Harlot to sleep. Wake the chosen player, show them the 'This character selected you' token, then the Harlot token. That player either nods their head yes or shakes their head no. If they nodded their head yes, wake the Harlot and show them the chosen player's character token. Then, you may decide that both players die.
ability: Each night*, choose a living player: if they agree, you learn their character, but you both might die.
flavor: Enchanté, Sailor. You look like you need someone to really listen to your troubles. I'm a good listener. Very, very good.

name: Druid
ability: Each night* you may choose a dead player; learn their character type and you might receive an evil potion.
otherNightReminder: Wake up the Druid and have them signal if they wish to use their ability. If they do, have them choose a dead player; they learn that player's character type. Put them to sleep, then decide if you want to put an evil potion of them or not.
flavor: The great use of life is to spend it for something that will outlast it.

name: Commira
otherNightReminder: Wake up the Commira and have them choose a player, put the Commira's Dead reminder token on that player. Then show them the Cauldron and have them pick up to 3 players (their choice) and put them back to sleep. Put a potion on each of the chosen players.
ability: Each night*, choose a player; they die. Then eye the cauldron and choose up to 3 players to receive a potion.
flavor:
Although mankind runs, ever fearful, from that pale rider, Death—
scouring the globe for a hidden key to save them from reckoning—
I have no need for secret salvation.

name: Clerk
ability: Each night*, you learn a type of potion that an evil player (not a traveller) has received tonight, or if none has been received.
otherNightReminder: Wake up the Clerk and either show them a potion of a type that an evil player has received tonight, or if none has been received by an evil player tonight, signal a no.
flavor: Employers are like horses — they require management.

special.name: card
special.value: An evil player received this potion

name: Baptist
ability: Each night*, choose 2 living players (not yourself); either player might receive a potion. If either received an evil potion you cannot die tonight.
otherNightReminder: Wake up the Baptist and have them choose 2 other, living players. Put the Baptist back to sleep. Then decide if you will put a Potion on one of them chosen players, and what type. If you put an evil Potion on either player, put the Cannot Die reminder token on the Baptist.
flavor: It's never too soon to contemplate eternal damnation, sir!

name: Merchant
otherNightReminder: Wake up the Merchant and have them choose 1 or 2. They may only choose 2 if they are, to their knowledge, holding a potion. If they choose 1, put a potion on them. If they choose 2, have them name a potion they think they hold and another, alive player. If they hold that potion, move it to the chosen player.
ability: Each night*, choose either 1) receive a potion, or if you hold a potion 2) choose a potion you think you are holding and a player (not yourself) to receive that potion.
flavor: I will buy with you, sell with you, talk with you, walk with you, and so following, but I will not eat with you, drink with you, nor pray with you.

name: Megalomaniac
firstNightReminder: Do not wake the Megalomaniac. Decide if a player should receive a Potion of Panic, and if one will, choose who.
otherNightReminder: Wake up the Megalomaniac and have them choose a player. Put the Megalomaniac to sleep. Put the Megalomaniac's Dead reminder token on the chosen player. Decide if a player should receive a Potion of Panic, and if one will, choose who.
ability: Each night*, choose a player; they die. Each night a player might receive a Potion of Panic. The dusk following the 3rd time a face-down Potion of Panic broke, evil wins.
flavor: I believe you find life such a problem because you think there are the good people and the bad people. You're wrong, of course. There are, always and only, the bad people, but some of them are on opposite sides.

name: Caetrum
otherNightReminder: Wake up the Caetrum and have them choose a player. Put the Caetrum to sleep. Put the Caetrum's Dead reminder token on the chosen player. As you remove the potions from the chosen player, you may move 1 of them to another player instead.
ability: Each night*, choose a player; they die. When a player dies this way, instead of breaking another player might receive 1 of their potions. Each night, a potion might break.
flavor: Guaranteed to solve any minor problem by turning it into a major desaster.

name: Fugitive
otherNightReminder: Wake up a living player and have them choose either 1 or 2, then put them to sleep. Wake up another living player and have them choose 1 or 2, then put them to sleep. If at least 1 of them choose 1, put a Good Potion on the other player. If only 1 of them chose 2, wake them and show them the other player and their potions. If both players chose 2, put an evil potion on both.
ability: Each night* 2 alive players choose either 1) The other receives a Good potion, or 2) to learn the other and their potions. If both choose 2, each receive an Evil potion instead.
flavor:
I've run so far away,
I ran all night and day,
so far away,
but I couldn't get away.

name: Tramp
ability: Each day & night cycle a player might receive false information. When you die, if you were mad that you are the Tramp, you keep your ability.
flavor: Bugrit, millennium hand an' shrimp...

name: Connoisseur
ability: Each day, you may visit the storyteller to learn a player that is a non-neutral execution for your team today. If you did not use this ability the last day you learn 2 players instead.
flavor: Everything in life that’s any fun, as somebody wisely observed, is either immoral, illegal or fattening.

name: Auctioneer
ability: On your 1st day, publicly declare a future day to be a Market Day. If you are alive on the Market Day, at dawn good potions equal to the day number are given out.
flavor: Aaaaaaaand, sold to the robed stranger with the pitchfork!

name: Student
ability: You may not nominate or vote if you have eyed the cauldron since dusk.
flavor: Education is not the filling of a pail, but the lighting of a fire.

name: Butterfingers
otherNightReminder: If Butterfingers was executed the previous day, replace each Good Potion in the Cauldron with Empty Potions.
ability: When you are executed, each good potion in play is emptied.
flavor: It took a special kind of man to cut his sword hand with his own sword.

name: Crone
ability: When you are attacked by the Demon you do not die. Instead, you swap characters.

name: Aberration
firstNightReminder: Wake up the Aberration and show them the Cauldron. Have them choose a player. Put the Aberration back to sleep and put a Potion of Panic on the chosen player.
otherNightReminder: Wake up the Aberration and show them the Cauldron. Have them choose a living player. Put the Aberration back to sleep and put a Potion of Panic on the chosen player.
ability: When a Potion of Panic is revealed, a player is poisoned until dawn. Each night, eye the cauldron and choose a player to receive a Potion of Panic.
flavor: There are horrors beyond life's edge that we do not suspect, and once in a while man's evil prying calls them just within our range.

name: Apothecary
ability: All types of potions you are holding are nullified.
flavor: Medicine is not only a science; it is also an art. It does not consist of compounding pills and plasters; it deals with the very processes of life, which must be understood before they may be guided.

name: Pigeon Fancier
ability: While dead, if you died at night, the Glassblower only gives out good potions. [+Glassblower]

otherNightReminder: Remove any 'No Ability' Reminder token. Put the 'No Ability' Reminder on any Townsfolk with any 'Trade' Reminder token on them. Wake each player with a 'Trade' Reminder on them and tell them they have received the Potions of the player with the corresponding 'Trade' Reminder on them.
name: Solicitor
ability: 2 living players may choose to trade all potions, and Townsfolk that do lose their ability till dawn. If either player is dead when the trade would happen, no trade occurs and no player loses their ability.

name: Socialist
ability: Up to three times each night when a player receives a potion (not from the Socialist); another player receives a potion of the opposite alignment.
flavor: The workers must seize the means of production!

name: Empty Potion
ability: You can hold duplicates of Empty Potion. This potion might break at any time.
flavor: A bottle is at it's most useful when it's empty.

name: Panic
ability: Cannot be nullified. This potion cannot be flipped back face down. When broken, if face down, it is announced at dawn.

name: Disdain
firstNightReminder: Wake up the Demon. Show them the Potion of Disdain and then show them an out-of-play character.
otherNightReminder: Wake up the Demon. Show them the Potion of Disdain and then show them an out-of-play character.
ability: At dusk this potion is nullified and breaks. If you nominate this potion breaks. When this potion breaks, the Demon learns a not-in-play Character.

name: Apathy
ability: When you are targeted by an evil player, if you are good, this potion breaks; they learn your character.
flavor: No death, no doom, no anguish can arouse the surpassing despair which flows from a loss of identity.

name: Obsession
firstNightReminder: Wake up the holder of the Potion of Obsession and show them the Potion of Obsession token.
otherNightReminder:
1. spot) Choose a player to receive a potion.
 2. spot) Wake up the holder of the Potion of Obsession and show them the Potion of Obsession token.
ability: If you are "mad" that you are a townsfolk, this potion might break and tonight another player receives a potion. You know that you are holding this potion.

name: Stress
ability: This potion might break to have its holder register as the opposite alignment or a character types of the opposite alignment once until dawn.

name: Terror
ability: Your good potions are face up during the night.

name: Conviction
firstNightReminder: If either living neighbor of the holder is holding at least 1 Potion that is not an Empty Potion, replace 1 of those Potions with a Potion of Conviction. Then replace this potion with an Empty Potion.
otherNightReminder: If either living neighbor of the holder is holding at least 1 Potion that is not an Empty Potion, replace 1 of those Potions with a Potion of Conviction. Then replace this potion with an Empty Potion.
ability: Each night, a living neighbor's non-empty potion becomes a Potion of Conviction and this potion is Emptied. When this potion breaks, all Empty Potions break.

name: Curiosity
ability: Each day you may exchange this Potion with the Storyteller privately for an Empty Potion to learn a player you have something in common with.

name: Empathy
firstNightReminder: Wake up the holder and show them the tokens of each type of evil potion held by their living neighbors.
otherNightReminder: Wake up the holder and show them the tokens of each type of evil potion held by their living neighbors.
ability: Each night you learn what evil potions your living neighbors are holding.
flavor: Now I know for certain; you feel for me as I feel for you.

name: Generosity
ability: If you would receive an evil Potion, this one breaks and another person receives that potion instead.

name: Joy
ability: If the demon kills you at night, a number of players equal to the number of living evil players receive a good potion.
